article_manifest.title: Defence and Security: SDF adapts to new threats, gains victories and anticipates challenges on the ground
article_manifest.original_title: Défense et Sécurité : Les FDS s’adaptent aux nouvelles menaces, engrangent des victoires et anticipent les défis sur le terrain
article_manifest.summary: Terrorist armed groups, employing mercenaries, with an imperialist agenda of destabilization, losing their bearings, are trying everything for the sake of it. Suicidal shrapnel shattered, such as attempts to attack air bases 101 and 401, and the terminal of Diori Hamani airport, in Niamey and Tahoua, the use of improvised explosive devices (IEDs) and kamikaze drones, they face a proven professionalism of the Nigerien Defence and Security Forces (FDS), after decisive strategic and tactical reforms.

The dialogue with the people took the form of a mini-conference .

article_manifest.title: Malian army under General Goïta: A powerful tool of sovereignty up to the challenges!
article_manifest.original_title: Armée Malienne sous le Général Goïta : Un puissant outil de souveraineté à la hauteur des défis!
article_manifest.summary: A concrete transformative work, with revolutionary essence, has been accomplished on the national defense tool in order to respond, with the greatest efficiency, to the immense security challenges generated by the current geopolitical context in Mali The Malian Army, by its irrepressible firepower, heroically stood up to the worst threats of the imperialist powers by bringing down the thunderbolt of hell on the enemies in the service of their subversive plans .

article_manifest.original_title: De Wagner à Africa Corps : la présence russe au Sahel en question

The General Staff of the Armed Forces claims to have regained control of the camp after fighting that resulted in casualties in the military ranks and among the attackers According to the statement issued Monday, August 10, the attack began around 5:30 a.m. and mobilized heavy machine guns, kamikaze drones, charge-dropping drones as well as two armored vehicles.

article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : six blessés évacués à Gao, le FLA parle de militaires libérés

article_manifest.title: Targeted financial sanctions: Bamako expands its security pressure tool

It is based on national texts relating to the fight against money laundering, the financing of terrorism and the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction . The grievances are formulated identically for the twelve names: alleged support for JNIM and the Azawad Liberation Front, promotion or apology of terrorism, criminal association and facilitation of terrorist acts.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: the Regional Security Council examines the security situation and recommends strengthening the existing system

article_manifest.title: 6 Burkina Faso: Night of the People's Progressive Revolution - The main achievements presented to the population

article_manifest.summary: On 22 September 2026, the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez arrested two individuals suspected of being involved in pregabalin trafficking. The operation resulted in the seizure of 6,900 capsules of this highly risky substance, discovered in the hands of the first suspect and at the home of the second .
